result.summary: The exact frozen Standard10 legacy-v4 observation bridge completed eight independent fresh625 generic-greedy sessions: -15.79 bb/100, raw 95% CI [-46.7802,15.2002], session-t7 CI [-39.8746,8.2946], and 4/8 positive sessions. This improved +80.8932 bb/100 versus the identical tensors naively rebound to v6 and reproduced the historical old-contract point within -4.3625 bb/100. Bridge-aware frozen-model replay, raw-hand CI, token/evidence, and observable deal-stream independence audits passed.
result.conclusion: The Standard10 clue was actionable: most of the naive v6 transfer loss came from observation-contract drift, especially preflop, not physical action sizing. Exact generic contract preservation recovered the historical near-zero regime but did not establish positive strength. The prior -18.5025 imitation-teacher evidence remains negative; no imitation learning occurred here.

Continue toward 100k only if its fixed fresh20k evidence supports it; otherwise use the bridge as a preserved initialization/reference for learned-weight improvement.
